segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the 42-seat plan for your service team and make sure the April 15 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, April 15 is still the date. We have 38 reps today, four managers, and then probably five seasonal seats in June. I need to know if those can be added mid-term.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They can. The base order would be 42 seats at $68 per seat per month, annual term starting April 1. Any seasonal seats can be added later at the same rate, prorated through March 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And implementation, you had quoted $4,800 one-time, right? That includes the data import from our current system?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, $4,800 one-time. That includes the account import, two admin training sessions, and one workflow review. The only thing not included is custom reporting beyond the three standard dashboards.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's fine. Procurement will ask about payment terms. Our standard is net 45, and we pay by ACH. Is that workable?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 45 and ACH are both on the quote. Total first-year subscription is $34,272, plus the $4,800 implementation, so $39,072 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. I also need the renewal language to say we get 60 days' notice before any price increase. Legal flagged that on another contract last quarter.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. The order form has 60-day written notice for price changes and a one-year initial term, April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. Renewal is annual unless either side gives 30 days' notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it over to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If it looks like what we discussed, I can get signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the quote and order form this afternoon, with Marcus copied, and I'll include the April 8 kickoff hold so your admins can plan around it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Thanks, yeah, that should keep us on track.
